explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1192: for every r ≥ 2 there is an asymptotic basis A of order r (f_r(n) > 0 for large n) with Σ_{n≤x} f_r(n)² ≪ x. f_r counts ordered r-tuples from A summing to n, which differs from unordered counts by at most a factor r!, irrelevant for ≪. The open question is stated affirmatively.
